Checking quality before delivery in bespoke tailoring

Making sure finished products meet what customers were promised.

The objective

Support the expansion of a bespoke tailoring business in Tokyo, including the introduction of a lower-priced suit, while keeping the quality its customers were used to.

Raju’s contribution

Raju was responsible for quality control on the manufacturing side before suits were delivered to clients, checking that finished products met the commitments made to customers and the standards they expected.

The outcome

Suits were checked against customer commitments before delivery. No measured results are reported.

Source: Raju Lalwani’s account.

The experience this brings

Holding production to the quality expectations of Japanese customers, and checking that what is delivered matches what was agreed.

Related services

  • Qualify and develop suppliers

Linked as transferable experience, not as a Japan–India assignment.
